name: Uptime Kuma (Self-Hosted)
description: Deploy Uptime Kuma, the self-hosted uptime monitor with status pages and 90+ notification channels. Runs the official image as a single ECS Fargate task behind a load balancer, with a managed RDS MariaDB database (~$97/mo).

cpu.title: Task CPU
cpu.description: Fargate CPU units for the Uptime Kuma task (256 = 0.25 vCPU). Raise it for hundreds of monitors.

memoryMiB.title: Task Memory (MiB)
memoryMiB.description: Fargate memory for the Uptime Kuma task. Must suit the CPU: 256 → 512–2048, 512 → 1024–4096, 1024 → 2048–4096, 2048 → 4096.

dbMultiAz.title: RDS Multi-AZ
dbMultiAz.description: Keep a standby database in a second availability zone. Doubles the database cost.

domainName.title: Custom Domain
domainName.description: Optional custom domain (e.g., status.example.com). Served over HTTPS with an ACM certificate.

hostedZoneId.title: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID
hostedZoneId.description: Hosted zone for the certificate validation and DNS records.

destroyDataOnDelete.title: Delete Data With the Stack
destroyDataOnDelete.description: Delete the database when the stack is deleted instead of keeping a final snapshot. Leave off unless the data is disposable.

estimatedCost.description: ~$97/mo: NAT gateway ~$33, load balancer ~$20, Fargate task ~$18, RDS db.t4g.micro ~$14, public IPv4 addresses ~$11, Secrets Manager and logs ~$1
